title: Ashford
text: Ogres have taken the old bridge on the north road… and no cart has crossed it in a week. Ashford is small, but its people are stubborn! Hold the town, raise an army… and clear that bridge.
script: [warm, storytelling] Ogres have taken the old bridge on the north road… and no cart has crossed it in a week. [proud] Ashford is small, but its people are stubborn! [resolute] Hold the town, raise an army… and clear that bridge.

title: Thornwood
text: The ogres are gone, and the old bridge is open again! The north road runs on east… into Thornwood forest. Across the next river, brigands and their cyclops chief have taken the timber town. Take it back from its garrison, and its dwellings are yours. Near the road, a spellbook lies on a marble altar… guarded by Stymphalian birds. Win it, and magic is yours. And this land is too wide for one rider. Ianthe, a priestess of Athena, waits at your Tavern. Hire her… and she'll hold the roads behind you.
script: [relieved] The ogres are gone, and the old bridge is open again! [storytelling] The north road runs on east… into Thornwood forest. [grim] Across the next river, brigands and their cyclops chief have taken the timber town. Take it back from its garrison, and its dwellings are yours. [intrigued] Near the road, a spellbook lies on a marble altar… guarded by Stymphalian birds. Win it, and magic is yours. [warm] And this land is too wide for one rider. Ianthe, a priestess of Athena, waits at your Tavern. Hire her… and she'll hold the roads behind you.

title: The Black Banner
text: Thornwood is free… and its foresters show Rowan an old trail, south, down through the trees. Somewhere below, a town called Eudora still keeps its gates shut against the Black Banner. Kassander of Korax flies that banner, a red raven on black, and he serves no crown. His riders want Eudora too. Get there first… or you'll be storming its walls! Beat him in the field, and he simply runs home and hires again. So take Korax… then hunt him down!
script: [grand, storytelling] Thornwood is free… and its foresters show Rowan an old trail, south, down through the trees. [mysterious] Somewhere below, a town called Eudora still keeps its gates shut against the Black Banner. [ominous] Kassander of Korax flies that banner, a red raven on black, and he serves no crown. [urgent] His riders want Eudora too. Get there first… or you'll be storming its walls! [wry] Beat him in the field, and he simply runs home and hires again. [resolute] So take Korax… then hunt him down!

title: Eudora opens its gates
text: Eudora's gates swing open! It held out against the Black Banner all this time… and now its walls, its garrison and its dwellings are yours.
script: [joyful] Eudora's gates swing open! [warm] It held out against the Black Banner all this time… and now its walls, its garrison and its dwellings are yours.

title: Eudora has fallen
text: Too late… Kassander's riders reached Eudora first. The red raven flies over its walls now. Take it back from him!
script: [dismayed] Too late… Kassander's riders reached Eudora first. [bitter] The red raven flies over its walls now. [determined] Take it back from him!

title: Kassander flees
text: Kassander turns his horse and runs! He's left his whole army on the field… but he'll hire another at home. Take his town, and he'll have nowhere left to run.
script: [scornful] Kassander turns his horse and runs! [wry] He's left his whole army on the field… [warning] but he'll hire another at home. Take his town, and he'll have nowhere left to run.

title: Korax is yours
text: Korax is yours! Kassander has no town left to run to… and your scouts are on his trail. Hunt him down!
script: [triumphant] Korax is yours! [eager] Kassander has no town left to run to… and your scouts are on his trail. Hunt him down!

title: Kassander is beaten
text: Kassander falls! The black banner is down… and it won't rise again.
script: [triumphant] Kassander falls! [solemn] The black banner is down… and it won't rise again.

title: The Border March is free
text: The Border March is free! From Ashford's bridge to the walls of Korax, the Crown's roads are open again… and Rowan's name is known in every town along them.
script: [warm, proud] The Border March is free! [storytelling] From Ashford's bridge to the walls of Korax, the Crown's roads are open again… [hopeful] and Rowan's name is known in every town along them.

title: Nekhen
text: Far to the south, where the Nile runs between two deserts, the flood is late this year. The great sluice of the canal is shut… and the Petsuchos lies across it, the temple's own crocodile, gone wild, with its brood. Neferet, priestess of Isis, holds Nekhen on the west bank. Her rites can curse a foe, ward a friend… and, with an Ankh, raise the fallen! Cross the river… and take the sluice back.
script: [grand, storytelling] Far to the south, where the Nile runs between two deserts, the flood is late this year. [ominous] The great sluice of the canal is shut… and the Petsuchos lies across it, the temple's own crocodile, gone wild, with its brood. [warm] Neferet, priestess of Isis, holds Nekhen on the west bank. Her rites can curse a foe, ward a friend… [hopeful] and, with an Ankh, raise the fallen! [resolute] Cross the river… and take the sluice back.

title: Abu
text: The sluice is open, and the flood comes at last! Up the river road, at the First Cataract, the Nile breaks white over black granite… and Sand Raiders hold Abu, the island fort at the kingdom's southern gate. Its walls are high… but Egypt's builders don't break walls. They raise ramps against them! Buy an Earth Ramp at your Workshop, choose your stretch of wall… and march straight up it. And Paser, a chariot captain, waits at your Tavern.
script: [triumphant] The sluice is open, and the flood comes at last! [storytelling] Up the river road, at the First Cataract, the Nile breaks white over black granite… [grim] and Sand Raiders hold Abu, the island fort at the kingdom's southern gate. [sly] Its walls are high… but Egypt's builders don't break walls. They raise ramps against them! [resolute] Buy an Earth Ramp at your Workshop, choose your stretch of wall… and march straight up it. [warm] And Paser, a chariot captain, waits at your Tavern.

title: The southern gate
text: Abu is ours again, and the raiders scatter into the desert! Boats run down from the cataract once more, heavy with granite and gold… Neferet watches the sunset from the island's walls. But out in the Red Land, a lord with no love for Isis has heard the news… and he is calling his chariots.
script: [triumphant] Abu is ours again, and the raiders scatter into the desert! [joyful] Boats run down from the cataract once more, heavy with granite and gold… [warm] Neferet watches the sunset from the island's walls. [ominous] But out in the Red Land, a lord with no love for Isis has heard the news… and he is calling his chariots.

title: The Red Land
text: Beyond the river lies Deshret, the Red Land… Set's own desert, where nothing green grows. There Sethi, a lord who serves Set, has raised his red banner over Nubt, the city of gold! He rides with our own chariots and our own ramps… and he means to rule both lands. Halfway across the sand, the caravan town of Gebtu still holds out. Whoever beats its garrison first holds the gold roads! And mind the sky: every few days, Set sends a storm. Take Nubt… and bring Sethi down!
script: [grand, storytelling] Beyond the river lies Deshret, the Red Land… Set's own desert, where nothing green grows. [ominous] There Sethi, a lord who serves Set, has raised his red banner over Nubt, the city of gold! [grim] He rides with our own chariots and our own ramps… and he means to rule both lands. [urgent] Halfway across the sand, the caravan town of Gebtu still holds out. Whoever beats its garrison first holds the gold roads! [wry] And mind the sky: every few days, Set sends a storm. [resolute] Take Nubt… and bring Sethi down!

title: The Two Lands are one
text: Sethi falls, and his red banner falls with him! The Red Land and the Black Land answer to one crown now… the Two Lands are one! From Nekhen's sluice to the gold of Nubt, the Nile runs free… and Neferet's name is sung on every boat that sails it.
script: [triumphant] Sethi falls, and his red banner falls with him! [solemn] The Red Land and the Black Land answer to one crown now… [joyful] the Two Lands are one! [warm] From Nekhen's sluice to the gold of Nubt, the Nile runs free… [hopeful] and Neferet's name is sung on every boat that sails it.
